keywords: EIP-8141 原子批量禁用 approval 合并
summary: 周六。8 月 5 日提交的 EIP-8141 PR 合并：原子批量中任何 frame 都不能声明 approval 作用域。EIP-8130 修正地址派生的 `actorId` 编码，改为与 Keystore 规范实现一致的右对齐，并合并。EIP-8164 补充说明账户转换后会发生什么变化。donnoh 公布自己的 Hegotá 排名。

items.title: EIP-8130：地址派生的 actorId 右对齐
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交并合并。原文所有地址派生的 `actorId` 公式写成左对齐的 `bytes32(bytes20(x))`，而参考 Keystore（`ActorId.fromAddress`）是右对齐的 `bytes32(uint256(uint160(x)))`，地址在低 20 字节。
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted and merged. Every address-derived `actorId` formula was written as the left-aligned `bytes32(bytes20(x))`, while the reference Keystore (`ActorId.fromAddress`) right-aligns as `bytes32(uint256(uint160(x)))`, with the address in the low 20 bytes.
items.topic_en: Settling details in the native AA specs

items.title: EIP-8164：说明对已转换账户的影响
items.note: （nezu511）提交。原有四项只说明其他账户不受影响，章节开头的“除非账户所有者主动转换”所指的情形没有在任何地方描述，PR 补上，不改规范行为。
items.title_en: EIP-8164: document effects on converted accounts
items.note_en: (nezu511), submitted. The four existing items explain why other accounts are unaffected, but the case named by the opening clause "unless the account owner explicitly converts" was not described anywhere; the PR fills it in with no normative change.

keywords_en: EIP-8141 no approval in atomic batches merged
summary_en: Saturday. The EIP-8141 PR submitted on August 5 was merged: no frame in an atomic batch may declare approval scope. EIP-8130 corrected its address-derived `actorId` encoding to the right alignment used by the canonical Keystore implementation, merged. EIP-8164 now spells out what changes once an account converts. donnoh published his Hegotá ranking.
